map.实际飞行时长 = (到达当地时刻 − 出发当地时刻) + (到达时区 − 出发时: Actual flight time = (arrival local time - departure local time) + (arrival time zone - departure time zone)
map.先按各自时区换算为同一基准（UTC）再相减，避免跨日与时差误差；结果为空中实际飞: First convert each to the same baseline (UTC) by time zone, then subtract, avoiding cross-day and time-zone errors; the result is the actual airborne flight time, excluding ground holding.

map.：北京出发 10:00（UTC+8）= 02:00 UTC，飞行 11 小时 →: : Beijing departure 10:00 (UTC+8) = 02:00 UTC, flight 11 hours -> arrival UTC 13:00. London UTC+0, local arrival 13:00. Ignoring time difference would miscalculate to next day; always unify to UTC then convert to local.
map.为什么要用 UTC 中间算？: Why compute via UTC in the middle?
map.跨越多个时区直接计算易错。正确做法：出发时间转 UTC → 加飞行时长得到达 U: Direct calculation across multiple time zones is error-prone. Correct approach: departure time to UTC -> add flight duration to get arrival UTC -> then to arrival local time zone. This tool follows this flow to avoid 'off by one day' errors.
map.飞行时长含滑行和时差吗？: Does flight duration include taxiing and time difference?
map.飞行时长指空中时间（轮挡到轮挡常含滑行），不含时差；时差只是显示换算。实际行程还: Flight duration means airborne time (ramp to ramp often includes taxiing), not time difference; time difference is only display conversion. Actual trip also needs check-in, immigration and ground transfer time.
